components.name: Tipo de Cliente (#ddTipo)
components.action: Options: Personal / Empresa / Extranjero. Likely toggles which of the other fields are enabled (several fields below load disabled by default, presumably until a type is chosen).

components.name: Password (#Password)
components.action: Account password. Loads disabled — presumably enabled after Tipo de Cliente / Identificación is set. Not verified further (would create a real account).

components.name: Teléfono (#ltelefono)
components.action: Free-text phone number (plain text input, not type=tel). Loads disabled.

components.name: Celular (#lcelular)
components.action: Free-text mobile number (plain text input, not type=tel). Loads disabled.

components.name: Email (#Email)
components.action: Primary email. Placeholder instructs multiple emails can be separated with ';'.

components.name: Email1 (#Email1)
components.action: Secondary email field, same ';'-separated-multiple convention. Having two separate fields both accepting ';'-separated lists is redundant/confusing UX worth flagging for redesign.

components.name: Sucursal (#lSucursal)
components.action: Branch/office picker — long list of physical Domipack branch locations (Oficina Principal, Naco, Boca Chica, Cap Cana, etc.).

components.name: Domicilio (#ckDomicilio)
components.action: Unlabeled checkbox next to Sucursal; presumed to toggle a home-delivery address option (not confirmed — no visible label text captured).

components.name: Medio (#cbMedioiD)
components.action: 'How did you hear about us' style dropdown — options include airlines, banks, social media, referral names, sponsorships, etc.

components.name: RUA (#ckRua)
components.action: Unlabeled checkbox, presumed related to a RUA (Recinto de Usuarios Aduaneros / customs user) declaration — not confirmed.

components.name: Submit (#bSend)
components.action: input[type=submit] with no visible text captured in the DOM dump (icon-only or CSS-generated label). Would create a real customer account — not submitted, per the audit's golden rule.

notes: Several fields (Password, Teléfono, Celular, Fecha de Nacimiento) load disabled, implying a client-side dependency on Tipo de Cliente/Identificación that was not exercised in this phase.
ckDomicilio and ckRua checkboxes have no captured accessible label/text — likely rely on adjacent plain text not programmatically associated via <label for> or aria-label.
